sub_graphs.title: Prague: SLOAD Instruction State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models the SLOAD operation that loads values from persistent storage to the stack

nodes.label: SLOAD Opcode Dispatched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched and dispatched the SLOAD (0x54) opcode for execution

nodes.label: Pop Storage Key
nodes.description: Pop the storage key from the stack and convert to 32-byte format

nodes.label: Storage Key Retrieved
nodes.description: The 32-byte storage key has been obtained from the stack

nodes.label: Check Access Set
nodes.description: Check if (address, key) tuple exists in evm.accessed_storage_keys

nodes.label: Storage Key is Cold
nodes.description: The storage slot has not been accessed before in this transaction

nodes.label: Storage Key is Warm
nodes.description: The storage slot was previously accessed in this transaction

nodes.label: Add to Access Set
nodes.description: Add (address, key) to accessed_storage_keys for future warm access

nodes.label: Charge Cold Access Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_COLD_SLOAD for first-time slot access

nodes.label: Charge Warm Access Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_WARM_ACCESS for previously accessed slot

nodes.label: Gas Charged
nodes.description: Appropriate gas cost has been deducted

nodes.label: Read from Blockchain State
nodes.description: Call get_storage() to retrieve value from evm.message.block_env.state

nodes.label: Storage Value Retrieved
nodes.description: The storage value has been loaded from persistent state

nodes.label: Push Value to Stack

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Increment PC by 1 to advance to next instruction

nodes.label: SLOAD Complete

sub_graphs.title: Prague: SSTORE Instruction State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models the SSTORE operation including gas metering, refunds, and state updates

nodes.label: SSTORE Opcode Dispatched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched and dispatched the SSTORE (0x55) opcode for execution

nodes.label: Check Gas Stipend
nodes.description: Verify gas_left > GAS_CALL_STIPEND to prevent reentrancy exploits

nodes.label: Insufficient Gas for SSTORE
nodes.description: Gas remaining is at or below stipend threshold, OutOfGasError raised

nodes.label: Check Static Context
nodes.description: Verify execution is not in a static call context

nodes.label: Static Context Violation
nodes.description: Write attempted in static context, WriteInStaticContext error raised

nodes.label: SSTORE Pre-checks Passed
nodes.description: Gas stipend and static context checks passed

nodes.label: Pop Key and Value
nodes.description: Pop storage key and new value from the stack

nodes.label: Get Original Value
nodes.description: Retrieve the value at transaction start (before any modifications)

nodes.label: Get Current Value
nodes.description: Retrieve the current value in the slot (may differ from original)

nodes.label: Original and Current Values Known
nodes.description: Both original_value and current_value are available for gas calculation

nodes.label: Check Cold Access
nodes.description: Determine if this is the first access to the storage slot

nodes.label: Charge Cold SLOAD Gas
nodes.description: Add GAS_COLD_SLOAD to cost for cold storage access

nodes.label: Calculate SSTORE Gas
nodes.description: Determine gas based on current vs new value (set vs update vs noop)

nodes.label: Gas Cost Calculated
nodes.description: Total SSTORE gas cost has been computed

nodes.label: Calculate Refund Adjustments
nodes.description: Update refund counter for storage clearing or value restoration

nodes.label: Charge SSTORE Gas
nodes.description: Deduct computed gas from gas_left

nodes.label: Update Storage State
nodes.description: Call set_storage() to write new value to persistent state

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Advance PC by 1

nodes.label: SSTORE Complete
nodes.description: Storage write operation finished successfully

edges.label: Warm access or after cold charge

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Storage Security Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models the security checks and protections for storage operations

nodes.label: Storage Operation Initiated
nodes.description: A storage-modifying operation has been requested

nodes.label: Verify Gas Stipend
nodes.description: Check gas_left > GAS_CALL_STIPEND (2300) to prevent reentrancy

nodes.label: Gas Stipend Violation
nodes.description: Insufficient gas remaining, operation blocked

nodes.label: Verify Not Static Context
nodes.description: Check that execution is not in STATICCALL context

nodes.label: Static Context Write Attempted
nodes.description: Write operation attempted in read-only context

nodes.label: Security Checks Passed
nodes.description: All security validations successful, operation can proceed

nodes.label: Validate Target Address
nodes.description: Ensure storage is accessed for current_target only

nodes.label: Storage Access Authorized
nodes.description: Access to storage for current contract is authorized

nodes.label: Track Access for Gas Oracle Prevention
nodes.description: Record access in accessed_storage_keys to prevent gas oracle attacks

ambiguities.text: The relationship between 'original_value' (value at transaction start) and 'current_value' (present value) in refund calculations is not fully explicit
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume original_value is snapshotted at transaction begin and current_value reflects all prior SSTORE operations within the transaction.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state what happens if a TLOAD reads a key that was never written in the transaction
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume reading an unset transient storage key returns zero, consistent with persistent storage semantics.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'gas remaining' in the stipend check could refer to gas before or after the operation's base cost
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the check happens before any gas is charged for the SSTORE operation itself, as a pre-flight validation.

implicit_assumptions.description: The accessed_storage_keys set is assumed to be correctly maintained across all message frames
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect warm/cold gas charging could enable gas oracle attacks or denial of service through unexpected gas costs.

implicit_assumptions.description: Transient storage is assumed to be completely isolated between transactions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cross-transaction state leakage could lead to reentrancy vulnerabilities or information disclosure.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot manipulate the static context flag through external means
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could bypass write protections in view functions, enabling state modification during supposedly read-only calls.

implicit_assumptions.description: The GAS_CALL_STIPEND check prevents reentrancy exploitation through gas manipulation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Reentrancy attacks could be enabled if contracts can be called with precisely controlled low gas amounts.
